targets.query: from(bucket: "k6") |> range(start: -15m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_reqs") |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: sum)

from(bucket: "k6") |> range(start: -15m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration") |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: (tables=<-, column) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.95, column: column))
from(bucket: "k6") |> range(start: -15m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_failed") |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean)
